title: About
text:
This site is built with Quarto and published from the repository root so it can stay close to your current GitHub Pages workflow.
The homepage is authored in Quarto, while the assignment deliverables remain the existing rendered HTML files under the unit folders.
If you add new assignments later, update the links in index.qmd and _quarto.yml, then run quarto render again.
